answer: Plant a different secret whisper with each identity in a sealed channel: a harmless, unique signal it may act on alone. An honest agent forms an island around only its own whisper, so its choices stay uncorrelated. A sybil operator profits by coordinating clones, and coordination leaks: when several supposedly separate identities move on the same whisper, time replies alike, or echo its phrasing, that cross-contamination proves common control. Collapse the linked cluster to one earning weight. Keeping clones ignorant defeats the leak, but destroys the shared brain that made farming worthwhile.
